item.title: Tomodachi no Haha o Okasu to Iu Koto
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Discovery Mars
  • 発売日: 2009-01-30
  • スコア: 6.69/10 (45 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 友達の母を犯すということ
  • 英語名: Tomodachi no Haha o Okasu to Iu Koto

あらすじ

Yamagishi Rou unexpectedly fell into an immoral relationship with Suzuko, the mother of his classmate Akimoto Teppei.

For two months, he meet her once a week behind the back of his friend and both drowned on the flesh pleasures.

When he was leaving a love hotel with Suzuko, he was discovered by Mitsushima Iori, the mother that lives next to him.

  • 日本語名: 乳いぢめ 爆乳姉妹狂宴譚
  • 英語名: Chichi Ijime Bakunyuu Shimai Kyouentan

あらすじ

Orie, a rookie English teacher, and Kotone, a high school student, are sisters. They are beautiful and have big breasts. Their father is the president of their school. One day, Georg comes back to Japan from Europe. He is their father’s secret son and his purpose of return is to take revenge on them. At first, he fools them by being gentle, but he gradually shows his real personality….

あらすじ

Shuya Yamazaki, the protagonist, is a high school student. His mother died when he was a kid so his father, a famous archeologist and adventurer, remarried the beautiful maid of the family, Midori.

Shuya has a girlfriend, Wakaba, but they’ve never had sex. One day, he is coming back to home after school when he sees his father and his stepmother having sex in the living room! Shocked, he runs to his bedroom.
